sanitized_input_policy_description: Construct a Day 10 pricing input from pre-match model content only. Exclude realized outcomes, sportsbook odds, close prices, ROI, edges, thresholds, and decision fields.
day9_to_day10_interface_policy_descripti: Day 10 uses the persisted Day 9 scoreline matrix directly as the single canonical goals probability object. It does not recompute Poisson probabilities from expected goals or rho.
day8_to_day10_corner_interface_policy_de: Day 10 uses the Day 8 predicted corner means, selected corner distribution family, and persisted dispersion parameter directly as the canonical corners object.
settlement_pricing_policy_description: Fair decimal price is 1 + L/W, where W = P(full_win) + 0.5*P(half_win) and L = P(full_loss) + 0.5*P(half_loss).
day11_probability_semantics_note: Settlement-aware fair prices are preserved directly. Day 11 must define how any derived model_probability or edge field represents push and quarter-line markets.
forward_production_fit_dependency_note: Historical Day 8 and Day 9 parameters in the loaded archive are valid for walk-forward evaluation, but they are not automatically a current forward-production snapshot.
